lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgSi₂ (Mg₄Si₈ per cell, 12 atoms, reduced formula MgSi₂) crystallizes in orthorhombic symmetry with space group Imm2 (No. 143), having six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Mg centers with four Si neighbors and Si centers with three or four Mg neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.58 to 2.87 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Si polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among like-centered Si polyhedra.
